posts.title: The Secret to Lasting Love | Eli J. Finkel | TED
posts.summary: Social psychologist Eli J. Finkel has spent decades studying what makes partnerships successful. In a practical talk drawing on lessons from pop culture, he explores why so many of us struggle to be true to ourselves in our relationships — and what the happiest couples do differently.
